all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: R&D tax credits reduce the cost of innovation investment, incentivizing private firms to increase research spending and develop new technologies, thereby raising productivity and long-term growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The text states 'A 25 percent credit for incremental research and development costs' under the August 1981 Economic Recovery Tax Act, indicating the measure was enacted into law.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The R&D tax credit is a significant innovation instrument that directly reduces the cost of private-sector R&D investment.
